Synergy Bonus.content:
Pairing certain Bots with the correct bots activates '''Synergy Bonuses''' for one or both of them. All Bots have at least one Synergy Bonus except Tier 1 Bots (which they had up to v1.0). If there is the same bot with mutliple tiers on the same team, only the bonus with the highest effect will take effect.

On this wiki, [[File:Synergy-incoming.jpg]] will represent incoming bonuses that bots receive, and [[File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg]] will represent outgoing bonuses bots give.

Note that most 2-Star Bots start with a level 2 Synergy, and 4-Star and 5-Star bots both cap at level 4, but 2022 Bots start with level 1 Synergies at 2-Stars and have four tiers to 5-Star.

Synergy.content:
A [[Bot]]'s '''Synergy''' is a special ability that activates when paired with another Bot with the same synergy.

== Common Synergies ==
Synergies common to all Bots are:
* {{Syn/Both}} '''Allies''' - +2~3~8 Armor
* {{Syn/Out}} '''Enemies''' - +2~3~8 Attack Rating
* {{Syn/Out}} '''Leadership''' - Acting as a beacon of leadership, all lower tier teammates gain +10% Armor Rating.

The latter is only available to 5-[[Star]] bots.
